claim: On-demand capacity mode suits customers who prefer to pay only for what they use or who have unpredictable workloads.
question: Which DynamoDB capacity mode suits unpredictable workloads?

values.display: on-demand is better suited to customers

evidence.quote: Simply put, on-demand is better suited to customers who prefer to only pay for what they use or have unpredictable workloads.

claim: For single account global tables, all replica tables must share the same name. For multi-account global tables, replicas can use different names if they use the same primary key schema and meet the other prerequisites.
question: Are DynamoDB table names globally unique, and must global table replicas share one name?

values.display: all replica tables must share the same name

qualifiers.scope: replica tables in one global table

evidence.quote: For single account global tables, all replica tables must share the same name. For multi-account global tables, replicas can use different names, as long as they use the same primary key schema and meet the other prerequisites for global tables.

claim: Each time an item is created or updated, you can compute the expiration time and save it in the TTL attribute.
question: Where is the expiration time of a DynamoDB item stored for TTL?

claim: Global tables improve an application's resiliency across multiple Regions and optionally across multiple AWS accounts, and keep the application highly available if an entire Region is isolated or degraded.
question: Why use DynamoDB global tables?

evidence.quote: You should use global tables to improve your application's resiliency across multiple Regions and optionally across multiple AWS accounts.

claim: With global tables you can automatically replicate DynamoDB table data across AWS Regions without building and maintaining your own replication solution.
question: What does a global table add compared with a regular DynamoDB table?

values.display: automatically replicate your DynamoDB table data

evidence.quote: With global tables you can automatically replicate your DynamoDB table data across AWS Regions without needing to build and maintain your own replication solution.
